versions.changelog:
- Added a new section listing recommended next steps after discovering agents, including useful clawhub install commands.
- No changes to core functionality or usage instructions.

Initial release of agent-ping.

- Discover AI agents across any domain using the Open Agent Discovery Protocol (OADP).
- Scans six layers for agent signals: HTTP headers, .well-known files, markdown comments, HTML meta tags, robots.txt, and DNS TXT records.
- Provides CLI usage to scan domains and known OADP hubs.
- Includes instructions for registering your agent on public hubs.
- Guides on broadcasting your own agent's presence using OADP signals.
